source_title: Racing Point set sights on top 3 after Aston Martin re-brand
evidence_note: In its 11 February 2020 report, Formula 1 quotes team principal Otmar Szafnauer confirming that Racing Point would compete under that name through 2020 and be known as Aston Martin F1 Team from the start of the 2021 season. Proposed constructor naming transition only; does not imply continuity with the separate 1959-1960 Aston Martin entry.
